From the Pallava rock-cut monuments at Mamallapuram to the temple towns beyond, with time to understand how the southern temple took shape.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Chennai
  • Mamallapuram
  • Kanchipuram
  • Travel or rest

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Chennai

    Arrival and an introduction to Pallava art.

  2. Day 2: Mamallapuram

    Rock-cut and structural monuments by the sea.

  3. Day 3: Kanchipuram

    The temple town, with a local partner.

  4. Day 4: Travel or rest

    On to another temple region if you choose one.

  5. Day 5: Plans, patrons and inscriptions

    A seminar, or a visit led by a partner specialist.

  6. Day 6: Departure

    A session on recording what you saw, then departure.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Explain how the southern temple took shape, starting from Pallava art.
  • Distinguish the rock-cut and structural monuments by the sea at Mamallapuram.
  • Discuss temple plans, patrons and inscriptions, and record what you saw on the journey.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.

Programmes in this journey

  • Mamallapuram: Rock-Cut and Structural Temples
  • Dravida Temple Architecture
  • Understanding Indian temple architecture
